# AD5X IFS Spoolman v0.6.9-beta

Repair release for native Fluidd delivery on AD5X/Z-Mod.

## Fixed
- native compatibility assets are now fetched through the documented AD5X Z-Mod chroot `/usr/data/.mod/.zmod`;
- the plugin checkout inside that chroot is addressed as `/opt/config/mod_data/plugins/ad5x_ifs_spoolman`;
- the installer no longer mixes the Moonraker process root with Z-Mod plugin paths;
- automatic legacy DOM/script installation remains disabled;
- migration no longer deletes a pre-existing working Fluidd UI before a native replacement has actually succeeded.

## Compatibility
- Sergey Fluidd: `v1.37.6`
- Native IFS UI patch revision: `10`

This is a runtime transport/migration repair. The native Fluidd overlay itself is unchanged.
